classification_taxonomy.completed: Explicitly deployed, closed, stopped, or terminal with no authorized immediate successor.
classification_taxonomy.collecting-frozen: Immutable candidate evidence is still being collected and current artifacts prohibit selection or deployment.
classification_taxonomy.blocked: A prerequisite, source gate, dependency, or governance hold prevents the intended next decision.
classification_taxonomy.actionable-now: A specific research action can begin now without contaminating frozen evidence, reusing spent confirmation evidence, or changing production.

governance_rules: Never rescue-tune a terminal branch on spent evidence.
Never call deployment actionable unless an existing artifact explicitly authorizes it.
Team Utility production architecture remains held unless a separately versioned preregistered successor is intentionally opened.
Unknown top-level research directories must be surfaced.
This audit may write only research/research-program-status-v1.
priority_rule: Choose only among actionable-now branches. Use priority_lanes in order, then stable registry order. Do not score current outcomes.
